title: Acquire approximate protection without an exact degeneracy
statement: For fixed r and depth k, grouping similar acquired coupling vectors and repeating complementary pair encodings keeps Theta(n) logical qubits in b=2^k physical blocks. Supplied bounds are max_(a,j)|v_aj|=O(n^(-k/r)) and sum_j|v_aj|=O(n^(1-k/r)), with O(rkn log n) classical work, O(n) encoder/inverse gates and explicit coefficient intervals. Protection can exist with all charge eigenvalues distinct: the reported 16-spin rational example has 65536 distinct eigenvalues. This does not invalidate old long-time capacity/entropy laws or identify a cheap physical calibration. Approximate decoherence-free spaces and pair protection receive established predecessor credit.

requires: Actual Hermitian commuting collective fields L_a=sum_i w_ai Z_i, fixed rank r, acquired coefficient intervals and specified generator D[L_a]; this is not arbitrary local noise.
Fixed depth k complementary-pair hierarchy and actual encoders/receivers; suitable trajectory-containing invariant subspaces are required for the control theorem.
All pulse duration/precision, external faults, calibration, source, measurement, decoding and terminal noise costs remain charged.
